title: BROKEN COPY of A01 — expectedLevel likely with one sign kind (validator must reject)

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's 1842 Clement Street, apartment 3. It's my father, he's 78.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Since lunch his words come out all mixed up and his right hand is weak, he can't lift his coffee cup.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Is he awake and breathing normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, he's awake, he's sitting on the couch, he just can't get the words out right.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: When was he last seen completely normal?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: He was fine at about 2 PM. We had lunch and he was fine.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Does he take any blood thinners, like Eliquis, Xarelto or warfarin?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, he takes Eliquis. For his heart.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Stay with him and keep the phone with you.
